subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the dormitories in the Fortress of Meropide
Go to the dormitories in the Fortress of Meropide

140040201.text: We once thought the Fortress of Meropide would be super scary, but looking back on it, it really wasn't that bad at all!

140040202.text: You've got a set schedule, guaranteed food and board, and you can even buy all kinds of stuff with Credit Coupons. It's really no surprise that many people don't even want to leave.

140040205.text: Oh, you mean Wriothesley? He's definitely a pretty impressive leader.

140040206.text: While he does look kind of intimidating, he's actually pretty easy to talk to once you've had a conversation or two with him.

140040207.text: Paimon wonders how he's like with the people here... Do they also get the same guy we do, or is he a lot harsher with the bad guys?

140040208.text: He probably has a good number of tricks for every situation.

140040209.text: Yeah... He must be doing something right to maintain order here, while not making everything feel super oppressive.

140040210.text: Excuse me, did I hear someone there? Could you please do me a favor?

140040211.text: Huh? Uh... Paimon could've sworn she just heard something...

140040213.text: Excuse me, is someone passing by? Could you do me a favor, please?

140040214.text: Nope, Paimon wasn't dreaming. There's someone over there for sure, but... Paimon doesn't see anyone...

140040215.text: Ah, did you two hear my call? Thank you so much... I'm over here, inside this big box.

140040216.text: #Uhh... You're inside the box!? No wonder Paimon didn't see anything... Well, c'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's go take a look.

140040217.text: Umm... Why are you hiding in here, anyway? If we hadn't happened to pass by, you could have been stuck for days!

140040218.text: Uhh, it's a bit complicated... Can we not talk about that for now?

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for the hat near the lift
Look for the hat near the box
Look for the hat near the railings

140040501.text: Nothing in the water, either... Paimon thought it might have gotten blown in...

140040502.text: We've looked everywhere, and still not seen anything that looks like a hat...

140040505.text: Huh, that's a good idea! If he's just looking to cover his head, then it shouldn't matter what kind of hat he's wearing.

140040506.text: Why don't we check out the Rag and Bone Shop? If memory serves, they've got all kinds of stuff in there!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Rag and Bone Shop

140040701.text: Eh? Paimon doesn't remember you being the boss...

140040702.text: Hahaha, I'm just standing in for Mr. Alvard while he's off restocking the shop.

140040703.text: #Now just wait a sec... a {M#blond}{F#blonde} foreigner dressed all in white, accompanied by a glaze-covered flying chunk of gingerbread...

140040704.text: You must be the legendary Traveler and their companion Paimon?

140040705.text: #No! Uh... Well, you're... half right? Paimon's {NICKNAME}'s treasured companion, sure, but she's not some flying chunk of gingerbread!

140040706.text: Sorry, sorry! I just... I never thought I'd get the chance to see you with my own eyes, so I got a bit ahead of myself.

140040707.text: I hope you'll find it in your magnanimous hearts to forgive my discourtesy. I'm just a nobody, after all.

140040708.text: Ah, there's no need to put yourself down like that! Paimon's just venting...

140040709.text: Well, your heroic actions at Erinnyes have long made their way to the Fortress of Meropide.

140040710.text: We heard that you were personally received by His Grace when you made your way down here, you know. Ah, you were the envy of all...

140040711.text: And you're now one of His Grace's favorite people, so of course, everyone wants to be introduced to you.

140040714.text: Haha, I figured you'd appreciate honesty over flattery.

140040715.text: After all, I also only joined up here because I'd heard Mr. Alvard was a good friend of the Duke.

140040716.text: And though I've only caught scant sight of His Grace since then, as fate would have it, I've become fast friends with Mr. Alvard himself.

140040717.text: I mean, we've all got agendas, but rather than trying to force something to be true, it's often better to just go with the flow.

140040718.text: Oh, so now, you're trying to kiss up to us.

140040719.text: Well, I did mean it when I called you legends, and it is indeed an honor to meet the two of you.

140040720.text: But enough of that — is there something you're looking for?

140040723.text: Feel free to check out anything you want. The Credit Coupon costs are on me.

140040724.text: Wait, but that's... You don't have to be so nice!

140040725.text: Well, it's not like I'm getting paid to watch this shop. Instead of Mora or coupons, Mr. Alvard usually just lets me take my pick of our goods.

140040726.text: Life's been pretty good recently, so I might as well just waive your bill. Never hurts to make some friends...

140040727.text: Well, if you put it that way...

140040728.text: Alright... Paimon will take a look...

140040729.text: After a moment's hesitation, Paimon manages to pick out two snacks.

140040730.text: Are you sure you don't want more? These opportunities don't come by every day, you know.

140040732.text: I never thought you'd turn down a chance to freeload...

140040733.text: Eh, it just doesn't feel the same if the owner's offering everything to you for free!

140040734.text: But anyway, we don't need to get into that right now. We can discuss Paimonology later — that poor guy must still be waiting for us.

140040735.text: Thank you so much! We'll be off, then.

140040736.text: No problem, and thank you for your patronage! I'd appreciate it if you could put in a nice word for our establishment the next time you speak to His Grace.

140040737.text: That's a real sneaky way of getting good reviews...

140040801.text: You can come out now! We've found your hat.

140040802.text: You did? Oh, Archons, you've just saved my life! Just one sec...

140040804.text: Wait, so you're not actually bald? You've got such a full head of hair, too!

140040805.text: *sigh* I mean, I told you that there had been a misunderstanding... This has nothing to do with my hair.

140040807.text: Well, we got you a new one! We tried really hard to look for your hat, but no dice.

140040808.text: To be precise, someone else gave it to us...

140040809.text: Ah, I see... Thank you so much. I'm really grateful, but unfortunately, there's just something special about my hat...

140040810.text: Does it have some kind of sentimental value?

140040812.text: Sorry, I can't... explain at the moment. Time's tight as well, so I suppose I'll keep looking for a while...

140040813.text: If you're looking for a hat, I just picked one up over here. Is it yours?

140040815.text: Oh, hey, Wriothesley! It's been a while.

140040816.text: It's a slow day today, so I decided to go for a little stroll. Even if your work space isn't cramped, it's still good to get some air.

140040817.text: I'll say, I'm not at all surprised to find the two of you here. You never could turn down someone's request for help.

140040818.text: Hehe, it's what good adventurers do, after all!

140040819.text: Is that so... Maybe I should consider asking the Adventurers' Guild to open a branch here.

140040820.text: As I recall, these hats are very important to members of the Beret Society. Best you avoid misplacing it again, hmm?

140040821.text: You might not have the same luck next time.

140040822.text: Understood. Th—Thank you so much, Your Grace.

140040823.text: Then... Then I'll be off. Umm... I—I'll get going now.

140040824.text: What a strange guy... Why'd he care so much about his hat?

140040825.text: Oh, and has he done something wrong? When he saw you, it was as if he'd seen a ghost.

140040826.text: Oh, not at all. In fact, members of the Beret Society are model prisoners. They work hard and never get into trouble — they've saved me a lot of work, in fact.

140040827.text: As for him... I'd guess he's just more of an introvert. It's not unusual for the more shy prisoners to freak out when I show up unannounced.

140040828.text: Huh? Shy? There are prisoners who are... afraid to talk to people?

140040829.text: Prisoners are still people, after all. There are as many crimes and motives as there are stars in the sky.

140040830.text: The idea of the criminal as a selfish, heartless brute is just a stereotype. Such labels could never capture the complexity of even a single individual person.

140040831.text: What kind of a person a prisoner may be, and why they have committed a crime — we'd never know these things if they don't share their story with us.

140040832.text: Huh, you've got a point... Anyway, it's all good as long as it makes sense to you.

140040835.text: Although most of the societies here will just turn individual brawls into mass ones...

140040836.text: The Beret Society does appear to be an exception in that it's instead trying to experiment with some novel and interesting things.

140040837.text: If you have some time, why don't we grab something at the Coupon Cafeteria? It'll give us some time to catch up, too.

140040838.text: And if you're still interested in the Berets after that, I can take you to their usual gathering place as well.

140040839.text: Paimon's not the biggest fan of that cafeteria, but if we're gonna catch up...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Coupon Cafeteria with Wriothesley

140040901.text: Welcome, Your Grace, and the Traveler. Would you like three orders of today's Welfare Meal?

140040902.text: Unfortunately, we weren't informed of your visit in advance, so we didn't prepare any Super Deluxe Welfare Meals today...

140040903.text: I'll pass on the food, then. What about you?

140040906.text: ...Then, Paimon will also pass. Paimon will save her stomach for something better!

140040907.text: What a pity... It would seem that none of us can properly appreciate your skills, Wolsey.

140040908.text: Haha, then I must beg Your Grace to find me some more ingredients, so I can come up with some more Welfare Meal recipes.

140040909.text: If you're not in the mood to eat, I can get you some drinks. We just got some great shipments in from above.

140040910.text: Yes please! Huh, Paimon didn't know you could get non-Welfare stuff at this place.

140040911.text: Haha, it's not for everyone. Think of it as a special treat for VIPs.

140040912.text: Ooh, now that's what Paimon likes to hear! In that case, two bottles of the drink for Paimon, please!

140040914.text: After a while, Wolsey brings out the drinks for everyone.

140040915.text: Our first meeting took place on short notice, and we were both swamped by everything that happened after, so there was no time for more casual chit-chat.

140040916.text: I'm actually quite fond of stories, you know. Of course, the others have already told me a lot about your deeds in Fontaine, but I'd love to hear it straight from the source.

140040917.text: Whoa, that'd be quite the long story...

140045001.text: I'm really sorry to bother you like this... Please come back soon!

140045101.text: Please come again! And don't forget to mention us to Your Grace!

140049902.text: Just where is that thing? This is taking longer than Paimon thought...
